---
title: "Module authoring contract"
---

## Handoff shape

A capability implementation is returned as exactly one self-contained `<module_name>/` folder, not a whole app/repository tree. Code sits at that folder root and documentation/examples live beneath its `docs/` directory. Exceptional shared-framework changes should be called out separately rather than hidden inside a fake full-tree handoff.

## Minimum architecture

1. Implement a `MethodMeshModule` object.
2. Expose canonical `As100Method` implementations with unique method IDs.
3. Own capability-specific screens/settings inside the module.
4. Expose every individual capability for direct use, presets, protocols and ODK.
5. Supply dashboard presence without moving capability logic into shared dashboard code.
6. Keep output names/types/semantics identical across projections.
7. Start in Development unless explicitly promoted.

## UX obligations

- use capability-specific polished UI where warranted;
- keep current results visible while working;
- make displayed returnable values tap-to-copy;
- use Commit as finalisation;
- reveal post-commit actions without forcing a generic result screen;
- preserve meaningful state across rotation;
- preserve launch origin for closeout.

## Offline and attribution

Document permissions, offline/online behaviour, third-party libraries/services, licence/terms, attribution and privacy/data egress.
